name: Have you identified and documented a service owner or information asset owner for each asset?
conditionsText:
Applies to all assets identified within the service, including:
- Data assets
- Applications
- Infrastructure
- Platforms
- Shared services
requirementTitle: Have you identified and documented a service owner or information asset owner for each asset?
requirementDescription: Does every important asset have a named person responsible for it?
why:
If nobody owns an asset:
- Security issues may not be addressed.
- Risks may not be reviewed.
- Decisions may be delayed.
- Vulnerabilities may remain unmanaged.
The guidance specifically highlights the need to understand who is responsible for each asset so that accountability for protection is clear.
tasks: Have you identified and documented a service owner or information asset owner for each asset?

actions.title: Have you identified and documented a service owner or information asset owner for each asset?
actions.description:
For every asset, there should be:
• A named owner.
• A defined role.
• Accountability for security decisions.
• Responsibility for managing risks relating to the asset.
